description: MgO rocksalt (primitive, 4x4x4 k, 30 Ry, NDLSS setups of tests/mgo): PBE-SL0r (PBE + onsite hybrid with SCAN-L double counting) from a cold start with Davidson+variational SCF and with friction MD (seeded from a converged PBE state), plus PBE0r and PBE for the hybrid shifts. KNOWN LIMITATION: RMM with the onsite hybrid reaches the correct energy but misses the lowest empty band (gap 6.54 instead of 4.23 eV; plain PBE RMM is fine), so its gap is not checked.
